What it means: The City of Boston Licensing Board [01:06] conducted a virtual meeting [01:17] chaired by Ava Calendar Concepcion on her official first day in the role [01:27, 01:35]. The board reviewed several alleged license violations involving city establishments [02:01, 02:08]. Cases heard included an alleged overservice violation involving two patrons at Old Trafford Inc., doing business as Paradise Rock Club, on June 15, 2026 [02:37, 04:33], an alleged staff assault on a patron at the same establishment on July 19, 2026 [25:38, 26:20], an assault and battery incident at La Grana Manzana on July 28, 2026 [39:15, 39:21, 47:19], and an alleged denial of accommodations at The Point on June 20, 2026 [52:42, 52:50, 54:10].

Who moved it: The meeting was led by Board Chairwoman Ava Calendar Concepcion [01:27, 01:30] alongside Commissioner Gregory Honan [01:48] and Commissioner Saxon [37:50]. Representatives from the Boston Police Department read official incident reports into the record [04:19, 26:14, 40:29, 53:51]. Licensees offered testimony and defenses through legal counsel including Attorney Dennis Quilty [02:55] and Attorney Ford [56:14], as well as venue staff and managers including Scott Turner [08:46], Bill Guera [16:56], Susie Hernandez [39:34], and Graham Gall [53:03, 57:48].

What to watch: The board took items one, two, and four under advisement [25:32, 38:00, 112:04] and will vote on the matters during a voting hearing scheduled for Thursday morning at 10:00 a.m. [113:01, 113:04]. Item three, concerning Emanuel Enterprises LLC, doing business as El Diamante [38:06, 38:58], was rescheduled to a later date [112:53] after no representative for the licensee appeared for the hearing [112:34, 112:48].

summary: On Tuesday, November 17, the board reviewed several disciplinary matters involving local establishments [01:08]. The board first discussed an April 27, 2026, incident at The Paradise, located at 967 Commonwealth Avenue, regarding two unconscious patrons found in a bathroom stall [02:39], [04:30], and took the matter under advisement [38:00]. The board next heard testimony on a May 17, 2026, incident at the Paradise Rock Club involving an alleged assault and battery by staff on a patron [25:45], [27:25], which was also taken under advisement [38:00]. Due to the licensee's absence, Chairman Concepcion decided to reschedule the hearing for Emanuel [38:05], [1:12:52]. The board then reviewed a July 28, 2026, assault and battery incident between a patron and security personnel at La Grana Manzana [39:15], [40:37]. Lastly, the board heard testimony regarding a June 20, 2026, alleged denial of public accommodation at The Point [52:40], [54:18], [55:48].
